description: Get a ghostswap.io link that opens the swap with the coins (and optionally the amount) already filled in. Give it to the user when they want to do the swap themselves in the browser, or when create_swap isn't available. The link creates nothing and never carries an address: the user enters their own receiving and refund address on the page and presses Exchange. Tickers are network-specific (usdtrx = USDT on Tron, usdt20 = USDT on Ethereum). Check the amount against get_pair or get_quote first; below the minimum the page shows a warning.

amountFrom.description: Optional amount of the "from" coin as a STRING (e.g. "0.05").

name: get_swap_link
title: Get a prefilled swap link
